title: Drummer Ernest Trepagnier
summary: Trepagnier was a fine timekeeper and master of parade drumming, playing bass drum on parade.

blocks.x: Okay, this just about finishes up. We can ask one more question about...
You asked something about Ernest Trepani, yeah?
No finer drummer in the city than him at no time. A fine fellow and a fine musician at all times. Jovial, laughing all the time, and one of the finest timekeepers you ever sat next to. Yeah, yeah.
Oh, he was the master of the parade. Of course, I never played with him on parade. But, I mean, all the other guys had the same acclamation as a parade man that I had for him as an orchestra man.
Was he a bass drum on parade?
Yeah, yeah. I used to play a bass.
